notes:
• Front of house / back of house: Settings → This PC. Set the back-room PC (scanners, Twin Turbo, printer) to Back of house — it keeps all the offers, holds, sorting orders, 3D jobs and settings and shows an address + key. On the front-desk PC pick Front of house and type them in: both PCs then see the same data live
• The front desk prints on its own label maker and on the back room's printers (they show as "Back room · …" in Settings → Printers) — no Windows printer sharing needed
• Each PC chooses its own tabs (front desk hides Scan, Labels and Inventory by default) and its own printers
• A red "Back PC offline" tag shows on the front desk if the back PC is off
